title: Cattle Daddy Media's Marketing & Content Creation Launch

ms.promise:
・1 x Content Research Report.
・1 x Content Strategy & Calendar.
ms.criteria:
The Content Research Report should include the following:
・Research into Cardano-related topics, trends, and audience preferences to inform the content creation strategy.
・Identify key themes, messaging pillars and content formats that resonate with the audience and align with the project objectives.
・A resource plan outlining what equipment and utilities are required for the campaigns to go ahead.

The Content Calendar should include the following: 
・Outline potential topics, posting schedules and distribution channels for effective content dissemination for the duration of the milestone.
・
ms.report:
Hi reviewers! 👋
This updated report demonstrates that we have successfully met the Outputs, Acceptance Criteria, and Evidence of Milestone Completion outlined in Milestone 1: Cattle Daddy Launch with Research and Content Strategy.
Based on the feedback received for the latest submission:
・We removed the unpopulated date tab as it was not intentionally included - as we cannot be sure on the dates of posts but aim to address them on a weekly basis as mentioned in the report (e.g 3 posts per week) 
・We populated the calendar we created with the links to published tweets 

Please note that this was not part of the milestone outline because we prepared the calendar ahead of publishing the tweets - however we included them due to your request. 
Appreciate the feedback and again, thank you in advance for taking the time to read our report.

ms.promise:
・15 x Videos.
・1 x Cattle Daddy Youtube (MooTube channel) with an intro video to Cattle Daddy Media.
ms.criteria:
・15 x videos in alignment with Cardano’s values and our content pillars to be created and shared from Lily Brodi and/or Cattle Daddy Media. These videos could be shorts, interviews, skits, reels, or live streams.
・Established Cattle Daddy YouTube (MooTube) channel and with an introductory video to Cattle Daddy Media.
ms.report:
Hello there!
We’re excited to submit our milestone deliverables for milestone 2.
In alignment with Cardano’s values and our content pillars, we have produced and published 15+ original video pieces through Lily Brodi and Cattle Daddy Media.
To date, these videos have generated a total of 183,658 impressions and 103,311 views, with strong community engagement across platforms.
We’ve also successfully launched the Cattle Daddy Media YouTube channel ("MooTube"), featuring an introductory video that outlines our vision and mission.
Please also see here for evidence of the launch of our Youtube Account as well as the Introductory video which is also shared on X.
To review our output, please refer to this document.
The document includes:
・Video links
・Individual performance metrics (impressions, likes, comments)
・Platform-specific analytics (YouTube, X, General)
・Please navigate using the tabs provided.

Thank you,
Team Cattle Daddy Media

ms.promise:
・1 x Content Analysis Report from our Smash Campaign.
・1 x Creator Contributor Board.
ms.criteria:
The Content Analysis Report should include the following:
・Data and metrics showing the success of our campaigns, along with feedback, improvements and key takeaways.The purpose of this report is to assist us in creating the Double Smash campaign and future content from Cattle Daddy Media.

The Creator Contributor Board should be the following:
・An online initiative (platform/channel TBC) which is open for other creators to contribute, collaborate and share ideas towards our Double Smash campaign and future Cattle Daddy Media content.
ms.report:
Dear Reviewers,
Please see attached for our submission, which includes the following:
1. Campaign Performance Report - Data and metrics demonstrating the success of our campaigns, alongside feedback, key improvements, and takeaways. This report is intended to inform the development of the Double Smash campaign and guide future content produced by Cattle Daddy Media.
2. Creator Contributor Board – An outline for an online initiative (platform/channel TBC) designed to be open to other creators, enabling them to contribute, collaborate, and share ideas in support of the Double Smash campaign and future Cattle Daddy Media content.
Thanks in advance!
